title: SolarLatticeProtocol
description: Build cities and factories to reach the stars!
body:
This modpack aims to provide an immersive but still decently lightweight enviroment to create modern cities, factories and vehicles.

### Features:
- **Create 6** - You can now build massive logistical facilities and huge factories with the new Create update, Create:TFMG and a few other support mods!
- **Valkyrien Skies** - With a fair few support mods like Clockwork and Trackwork lets you build ships, planes, cars or whatever vehicles you need for your projects.
- **Ad Astra** - One of the main goals of this pack is to step into the space age.
- **Applied Energetics 2** - If you get to the point where the logistics provided by Create doesn't satisfy your needs anymore, you can use AE2!
- **Computer Craft** - Totally optional, but if you take your time learning a bit of coding with this mod, you will unlock so much possibilities from controlling your factories to doing complex movements with your vehicles or even automating them entirely!

### Plans for the future: 
- Adding a _Quest Book_ to log progression, guiding the player through the different mods and helping with creating more advanced production lines, as well as working as a wiki for the modpack.
- Adding custom VS weights to most blocks. (At the moment only a few locometal blocks are done, vanilla and some create mod blocks already have custom weights out of the box)
- Adding custom recipes to TaCZ guns, attachments and ammunitons.
- Adding ways to automate zinc and copper production.
- Creating a GitHub project mainly for bug reports.
- Adding CBCModern Warfare when a supported version comes out for the new VS update
- Updating this description page and the galery.
- Adding downloadable server files. (You can still run this modpack in a server, but you will have to manually remove the client-side mods from the server mods folder)
